pose: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied anime character illustration for a desktop companion app. Change ONLY the upper brown-haired adult woman's two arms and hands into a relaxed affectionate resting pose. Her arm on the viewer's left bends naturally down and inward, and its relaxed open hand rests gently on the visible upper-left crown of her purple-haired adult friend, fingers softly following the purple hair. The crown contact should be around image x=42%, y=51%; keep the friend's face clear. Her arm on the viewer's right bends comfortably down, with its hand resting naturally on her own right-side lap around x=67%, y=49%. This is a gentle friendly head-pat, not gripping or pressing. Exactly two anatomically coherent arms, two hands with five natural fingers each; sleeve cuffs connect cleanly to wrists. Match the original dark plum sleeves, cream cuffs, gold buttons, hand scale and line-art style. Preserve the existing shoulder attachment points. Preserve both faces, hair, expressions, torso, outfits, existing skirt design and silhouette, seated body arrangement, legs and shoes, camera, scale, framing, and all positions outside the changed arms. Do not add a desk, keyboard, mouse or other props. Keep the same plain light-gray background. Full original composition, no crop. The sole requested change is the two-arm resting gesture.
cutout: Use case: background-extraction. Create a precise transparent sprite cutout from this finished illustration. Keep ONLY the upper brown-haired woman's TWO complete arms: the dark plum sleeves starting at their shoulder caps, cream cuffs and gold buttons, and both attached hands including every finger. Preserve their exact existing shape, scale, colors, texture, pose and relative placement. The viewer-left hand hangs downward with softly curved fingers; the viewer-right hand is resting diagonally inward. Remove all other content completely: all faces, heads, hair (including the purple hair beneath the left hand), torso, bodice, skirt, legs, shoes, friend, and background. The empty space between the arms and around the fingers must be true transparent alpha, with clean carefully traced edges. Do not invent missing body parts, change the hand gestures, add extra hands, rearrange or independently rotate the arms. Output on the same full portrait canvas and keep the two arms at the same pixel-relative positions as the input image, with generous empty transparent space corresponding to all removed content.
